hints.title: Proximity Condition
hints.text: For each element x in arr1, check if there exists any element y in arr2 such that abs(x - y) <= d.

hints.title: Sort arr2 for Fast Lookup
hints.text: Sort arr2 in ascending order. Then use a sorted search to locate elements nearest to x.

hints.title: Closest Neighbors
hints.text: Check the element at insertion point and its predecessor. If neither satisfies abs(x - y) <= d, increment the count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every pair takes O(N * M) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting arr2 takes O(M * log M), allowing O(log M) proximity checks for each element of arr1.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate sorts the second array and uses logarithmic bisection to verify distance boundaries.
